newsitem.title: FRANCE: French safety chief hopes Etunnel HGV restart soon.
newsitem.headline: French safety chief hopes Etunnel HGV restart soon.

text.p: A French transport safety official said on Tuesday he hoped there would be no major obstacles to Eurotunnel SA /PLC restarting freight traffic by mid-June as planned by the company.
"I hope there'll be no insurmountable problems on this," Jean-Pierre Ghuysen, head of the French delegation on the Channel Tunnel Safety Authority told a news conference here.
He was responding when asked whether Eurotunnel would be able to restart full commercial freight service by mid-June.

Eurotunnel hopes to gradually build up its freight service from May 15 to a full service by mid-June, if safety approval is granted by the Anglo-french Intergovernmental Commission in the wake of the November 18 fire, which interrupted all services for a period.
Eurotunnel is asking selected customers to restart freight services from May 15.
